# Architecture Question 86 — Idempotency and safe retries

This follows directly from resumable multi-domain workflows.

> Retry `CreateCharacter(Maya)`

> Retry a paid generation Job after a timeout

So I think **idempotency** should be a first-class runtime principle.

In plain English:

> **Repeating the same operation should not accidentally perform the same logical action twice.**

If Factory sees `OP-184` again, the domain service can say:

> “Already completed; here is the result.”

rather than applying it again.
